title: metrosp
text: Lines 4/5 — passengers_transported: available Dataverse source; entrance data covered Lines 4/5 — station_code: lines station code source (station_code = NA) 2017: Oct-Dec available (full year) 2025: Trailing months may NA values (data yet published) Station metrics: weekday average (mdu) available station level forecasts / forecast_accuracy: Derived passengers_entrance total build_forecasts.R; require forecast package (Suggests). Box-Cox back-transform COVID dip can blow CV error, MAPE > 200% capped NA treated model failure. station_inauguration: Stations open data window inauguration_date = NA pre_data_window = TRUE; ramp_up_end = opening + 180 days marks period exclude baseline comparisons. Dates need manual verified = TRUE cross-checking sources.

title: metrosp
text: ETL runs targets pipeline (primary) defined data-raw/_targets.R (store: data-raw/_targets/, config: _targets.yaml). Pure functions live data-raw/R/ (loaded via tar_source()); package R/ still holds data.R. graph assembles data/*.rda committed processed/ CSVs, GeoSampa GPKGs, station_inauguration.csv. Forecasts graph yet (build_forecasts.R stays standalone script). Routine data update (common case — fetch new METRO + Lines 4/5 data): Flags env vars, replacing old run_pipeline.R booleans. gates side-effecting refresh rewrites committed CSVs place; unset (default ) means rebuild offline CSVs: column/definition change needs flag: edit relevant assemble_*() dims.R function targets rebuilds affected datasets + descendants. Inspect targets::tar_visnetwork(); read result tar_read(<name>). Legacy path (still present, retired): source("data-raw/run_pipeline.R") -file boolean flags. paths produce byte-identical data/*.rda.
code: METROSP_DOWNLOAD=true METROSP_DATAVERSE=true Rscript -e 'targets::tar_make()' Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'   # outside the graph; refreshes man/*.Rd

title: Getting Started
text: metrosp package provides access Metro de São Paulo public transportation data. Since data updated regularly datasets rather compact, package distributes data “lazy” format. means data comes prepackaged called directly, without needing download import raw data. four main datasets: passengers_entrance: daily passengers entering metro system passengers_transported: daily passengers transported metro system station_averages: daily average passengers per station station_daily: daily passengers per station convenience, metrosp also provides information stations lines metro system (lines, stations, metro_lines). lines dataset spatial dataset requires sf package work properly. Finally, package also provides named vector colors line metro system (metro_colors). Using datasets straightforward, just call dataset name. datasets returned tibble using dplyr package recommended.

title: Getting Started
text: tutorial briefly introduce main datasets use making simple visualizations data. better replicate visualization, use ggplot2 package custom theme . passengers_entrance passengers_transported datasets monthly passengers entering transported metro system. former daily count passengers entering metro system, latter daily count passengers transported metro system. data aggregated metrics: max: maximum number passengers (daily peak) mdu: average number passengers business days mdo: average number passengers Sundays msa: average number passengers Saturdays total: total number passengers dataset identified month (date), line (line_number, line_name), metric (metric_abb, metric). data tidy format. Note special line defined aggregate total METRÔ system (line_name = "METRO System" line_num = 99). uses, ’s best filter line. plot shows total monthly passenger entrances metro line. Note line-5 series interrupted since ownership line transferred ViaMobilidade 2018.  dataset identified month (date), line (line_number, line_name), metric (metric_abb, metric). data tidy format. columns passengers_entrance thousands passengers. Also, dataset currently includes data METRÔ operated system. future, dataset may expanded include lines 4 5. Note special line defined aggregate total METRÔ system (line_name = "METRO System" line_num = 99). uses, ’s best filter line. plot shows daily average (business days) passenger transported metro line.  dataset identified month (date), line (line_number, line_name), station (station_name). value column available avg_passenger, daily average (business days) passengers entering station. plot shows daily average (business days) passengers entering station line 4. Note temporal range data unequal across stations, since inaugurated time.  dataset identified day (date), line (line_number, line_name), station (station_name). value column available passengers, daily number passengers entering station. Additionally, column station_code contains three letter abbreviations stations, METRÔ operated lines. plot shows trend daily passengers entering station line 4 2023.

title: Six-Month Demand Forecasts by Line and Model — forecasts
text: data frame one row per (line, model, forecast date): line_number Metro line number: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 15 (integer). model Model identifier (character). One : "arima" (Box-Cox auto.arima seasonal search), "ets" (Box-Cox state-space exponential smoothing), "stlf" (robust STL decomposition + ETS seasonally adjusted remainder). date First day forecast month (Date). Six rows per (line, model), starting one month last observed value. mean Point forecast — back-transformed bias-adjusted (numeric). lo80, hi80 80% prediction interval (numeric). lo95, hi95 95% prediction interval (numeric).

title: Six-Month Demand Forecasts by Line and Model — forecasts
text: Forecasts built data-raw/build_forecasts.R passengers_entrance (metric_abb == "total") refreshed whenever underlying data updated. build script also produces forecast_accuracy, reports --sample error (line, model) consumer can pick preferred model per line. Modelling choices: three models use lambda = "auto" (Guerrero estimate) biasadj = TRUE, point forecasts means rather medians original scale. stlf uses robust = TRUE, -weights 2020–2021 COVID period seasonal extraction without requiring explicit intervention dummy.

text: sf data frame POINT geometry (CRS: WGS84 / EPSG:4326) following columns: station_name Station name title case (character). line_number Line number station belongs (integer). line_name_pt Portuguese color name line (character). line_name English color name line (character). company_name Operating company name (character). type Either "metro" (METRO SP) "train" (CPTM) (character). status Either "current" (operating) "future" (planned expansion) (character). geometry Station location (sfc_POINT).

title: Metro and Train Station Locations — stations
text: GeoSampa, Prefeitura de São Paulo. https://geosampa.prefeitura.sp.gov.br/

title: Metro and Train Station Locations — stations
text: Requires sf package work spatial features. distinction types follows GeoSampa's classification. Broadly, "metro" lines run underground subway "train" lines run ground commuter rail, though exceptions exist.
